name: ONEOK WesTex Transmission
researcher_notes: The ONEOK WesTex Transmission page on oneok.com says the system is an intrastate pipeline in Texas of about 2,217 miles, with pipe sizes up to 24 inches. It says peak day capacity is 777 MMcf per day and it links the Texas Panhandle, Permian Basin and Waha Hub, moving gas between the Mid-Continent and Waha. No GEM row exists for this system under any name; ONEOK's other rows are Guardian, Midwestern, Viking and Northern Border. This is an operating legacy system, so the new-pipe length rule applies to its full sourced length. Only one source was found (the operator page), so confidence is high for a single validated source. Not found: a second independent source, the year it started, a route map, and the Texas Railroad Commission filing. Diameter 24 is the maximum, not a single size. Owner entity ONEOK Inc already exists in the ownership list. Intrastate line, so no FERC filing is expected.
